result.topic_en: A calculation transforming the integral of X δx' + Y δy' + Z δz' over space and time, via integration by parts, into the variation of an integral of squared first derivatives of the displacement (wave-equation action).
result.transcription:
$\int (X\delta x' + Y\delta y' + Z\delta z')\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt =$
$= \int \Big\{ cc\Big(\frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial z^2}\Big) - \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial t^2} \Big\}\, \delta x'\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$
$+ \quad . \quad . \quad .$
$+ \quad . \quad . \quad .$
$= \; . \; . \; - \int \Big\{ cc\Big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial x'}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial x'}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial z}\Big) - \frac{\partial x'}{\partial t}\cdot\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial t} \Big\}\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$
$. \; . \; - \quad . \quad .$
$. \; . \; - \quad . \quad .$
$= \; . \; . \; - \delta \int \tfrac{1}{2}[?] \Big\{ cc\Big(\big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}\big)^2 + \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial y}\big)^2 + \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial z}\big)^2\Big) - \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial t}\big)^2 \Big\}\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$
$-$

methods.what: Force components expressed through the wave operator acting on displacement x' (and analogously y', z')
methods.quote: $= \int \Big\{ cc\Big(\frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial z^2}\Big) - \frac{\partial^2 x'}{\partial t^2} \Big\}\, \delta x'\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$

methods.what: Integration by parts transferring derivatives onto the variation δx'
methods.quote: $= \; . \; . \; - \int \Big\{ cc\Big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial x'}{\partial y}\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial x'}{\partial z}\cdot\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial z}\Big) - \frac{\partial x'}{\partial t}\cdot\frac{\partial \delta x'}{\partial t} \Big\}\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$

methods.what: Virtual work written as the variation of a quadratic action integral (variational principle for the wave equation)
methods.quote: $= \; . \; . \; - \delta \int \tfrac{1}{2}[?] \Big\{ cc\Big(\big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}\big)^2 + \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial y}\big)^2 + \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial z}\big)^2\Big) - \big(\frac{\partial x'}{\partial t}\big)^2 \Big\}\, dx\, dy\, dz\, dt$
